Cost: 250eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Replaces the mouth and nose with a hot-swappable plated facemask. Might want to bring a straw.

External Body Cyberware. Borgware. Functions as an installation of Nasal Filters, and anyone attempting Human Perception Checks against an individual with this cyberware suffers a -2 penalty to their Check. Incompatible with Advanced Cyber-Jaw Cyberware. Additional Faceplates exist in nearly any style from bright pink, gunmetal gray, animal snout, etc, and may be purchased for 50eb (Costly).

NOTE: Think Kiwi from Edgerunners.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.
  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).
